title: Chapter 199 - 199 What Did You Do? Apologize!
content:
Chapter 199 - 199 What Did You Do? Apologize!

Chapter 199 - 199 What Did You Do? Apologize!

199 What Did You Do? Apologize!

Liu Siqi looked at Lin Fan’s serious face as he made the calls. He kept telling them not to eat with Chen Kai. She almost laughed out loud.

At that moment, she saw Lin Fan hang up the call and could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, who were you on the phone with just now?”

“Oh, didn’t you say that your husband is very busy?” Lin Fan said calmly. “He doesn’t have time to accompany you, right?

“I called the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City and told them not to have dinner with your husband.”

“Hahaha!”

Liu Siqi held her stomach and laughed so hard that she almost cried.

Lin Fan…

First, he called the general manager of the Imperial Hotel and asked him to book a hall there for her husband.

Then, he called the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City and told them not to have dinner with her husband.

Who did he think he was?

He was just an ordinary student!

How could he have the phone numbers of these big shots?

Would these big shots listen to him?

What a joke!

Liu Siqi was laughing as she said “Qiu… Qiu Ziqian… It’s not that I want to laugh. It’s just… It’s just that your boyfriend is too funny…

“Oh, I can’t take it anymore…

“My stomach hurts from laughing.”

Qiu Ziqian did not reply. She just looked at Lin Fan with admiration.

It was because she knew… this was definitely not a joke!

At this moment, Liu Siqi’s phone rang.

She was laughing so hard that her hands were trembling. She picked up her phone and looked at the incoming call notification.

It was her husband, Chen Kai.

“Hello, hubby…” Liu Siqi laughed.

“Liu Siqi, what the hell are you doing?!” Chen Kai’s stern voice came from the phone.

This roar shocked Liu Siqi so much that her entire body trembled.

She stammered, “What… What am I doing?”

“The general manager of the Imperial Hotel just called and said that you booked an entire floor for me! When did I ask you to book it?” Chen Kai shouted.

“What? I… I…” Liu Siqi was completely dumbfounded.

“Do you know how much it costs to book an entire floor of the luxurious hall? 1.5 million! Are you crazy?” Chen Kai shouted.

“Hubby, I… I thought it was a joke…” Liu Siqi panicked.

“Are you kidding me? You thought it was a f*cking joke and I have to spend 1.5 million! Don’t do such a stupid thing again!” Chen Kai shouted and hung up the call.

Liu Siqi was still in a daze when she heard the busy tone on the phone.

He had spent 1.5 million yuan to book an entire floor of the luxurious hotel…

This…

This…

Then, Liu Siqi turned to look at Lin Fan.

It was him!

It was him!

He had really called the general manager of the Imperial Hotel just now!

He was not joking!

If that was the case…

Then did he really call the chairman of Yinshan Group and Xiao Wu Wholesale City just now?

If this was true…

Then…

Liu Siqi’s face turned pale instantly. A bad premonition surged into her heart like a tidal wave.

At this moment, Liu Siqi’s phone rang again.

The ringing of the bell was like the roar of a malicious spirit, causing her to tremble in fear.

Then, Liu Siqi picked up her phone shakily. When she saw that the caller ID was her husband, Chen Kai, her entire body trembled even more.

“Liu Siqi! What the hell did you do?

“Do you know how much effort I’ve put in to build a relationship with the chairman of the Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City?

“Do you know how much I paid to invite them to dinner?

“It’s all ruined now! Do you know how much I’ve lost?”

As soon as the call connected, Chen Kai’s roar came from the other end.

“Hubby… What happened?” Liu Siqi said guiltily.

“What happened? Good! Let me tell you! Just now, the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City called me and told me that because I have to accompany my wife, they won’t be eating with me anymore!” Chen Kai shouted, “Liu Siqi, why are you so shameless?

“Damn it! Tell me, have I not accompanied you enough?

“Let me tell you, I’ve had enough!

“If you don’t change the minds of the two chairmen, you can just get lost!”

Chen Kai hung up the phone after shouting.

These words were like thunder on a sunny day, echoing in Liu Siqi’s ears. She was so scared that her fingers were weak. If she was not careful, her phone would fall to the ground.

It was the sound of her phone falling that finally brought Liu Siqi back to her senses.

She quickly turned to look at Lin Fan and bowed, “I’m sorry. It was my fault just now. It was my fault… Please, let me go…

“I’m sorry, I’m sorry…”

At this moment, no matter how stupid she was, she knew that Lin Fan was definitely not an ordinary student.

He was a true big shot!

Lin Fan said calmly, “What do you mean by this? Didn’t I help you book the hotel as you said? Then, I told the chairman of Yinshan Group and the chairman of Xiao Wu Wholesale City not to have dinner with your husband.

“You don’t have to be so polite. After all, you’re Ziqian’s classmate.”

How could Liu Siqi not understand what Lin Fan meant? She bent her legs and knelt in front of Qiu Ziqian.

“Ziqian, it was my fault just now… I’m sorry. I shouldn’t have spoken nonsense…

“I beg of you, please forgive me this time on account of us being classmates…”

She lowered her head and clenched her fists. Her face was filled with resentment and anger.

There was no doubt that Liu Siqi would definitely take revenge for today if she had the chance in the future!

Liu Siqi’s sudden kneeling shocked Qiu Ziqian.

Qiu Ziqian did not notice the change in Liu Siqi’s expression and actions.

As a result, she did not know what to do.

Hence, Qiu Ziqian looked at Lin Fan and asked for his opinion.

Liu Siqi’s actions were hidden from Qiu Ziqian, but how could she hide from Lin Fan?

Lin Fan held Qiu Ziqian’s slender waist and said, “Let’s go. It’s better to teach some people a lesson.”

Qiu Ziqian immediately understood what Lin Fan was thinking. Even if she forgave some people, they probably would not have any regrets.

After entering the SK Mall, Qiu Ziqian looked at Lin Fan with a puzzled gaze.

It was as if she was asking, ‘How do you know so many chairmen? Moreover, you can directly request them.’

Lin Fan easily understood her thoughts. He rubbed his nose and said, “You should know that I own 51% of the shares of Xiao Wu Wholesale City.

“Also, I’ve bought 51% of Yinshan Group’s shares.

“As for the Imperial Hotel… it belongs to me completely.”

Silence!

The surrounding air seemed to have quietened down.

Qiu Ziqian could not help but gape, unable to close her mouth for a long time.
